action_summary: This round released the compile layer -- the measured wall (32/38 realistic sentences failing before any dispatch, PR #6760's corrected diagnosis) -- with a general mechanism and answered the owner's weight-space theory with freshly fetched 2026 research. MECHANISM: canonical/runtime/effect_directed_compile_v1.py routes a sentence to a declared capability when (1) the named artifact's format is verifier-checkable (the carrier gate's own evidence bar), (2) the IDF-weighted overlap between the sentence's stemmed content tokens and the candidate's reviewed keywords/provides reaches 0.8 (path fragments never vote; two mid-frequency tokens or one rare and one common open the gate; word soup does not), and (3) every non-knob argument binds from the sentence -- an unbindable argument refuses the row; operation-shaped arguments are never guessed. Execution goes through the R29 confined seam; the first VERIFIED candidate wins; attempts are recorded; a failing run is fail-closed WITH its receipt, now naming the adapter's own reason (CONFINED_ADAPTER_RAISED in confined_dispatch_v1 -- silence about why is how a compile gap got misread as a sandbox gap). The tree-sitter capability was added to the declarations after review (VERIFIED_BOUND_CAPABILITY with an independent test). The door insertion is 9 lines between the honest-refusal check and the carrier gate. MEASURED: probe on the committed tree: EXECUTED 3 to 8 (PR2a predicted >=8), ROUTED_ELSEWHERE 3 to 11, NOT_COMPILED 32 to 18, all rows named; 5 effect-directed confined passes (tree-sitter index, AST symbol index, test selection, crosshair contract check, crosshair concrete-execution oracle) and 4 honest fail-closed rows (the material a clean clone lacks); 8/8 new tests; seam suite 5/5; guards at clean-tree baseline; tree-sitter run-to-run variance recorded honestly as a capability-side question. WEB (all four owner-cited sources fetched and real): Experience Distillation (arXiv 2607.21051) retains 64.8-93.4% of ICL gains in weights while direct SFT recovers 3.8%, matching RL with 9.6x fewer samples, accumulating over cycles; ASCENT (arXiv 2610.05303) distills ONLY verified experience into LoRA fast weights (+22 points, held-out transfer) and its central negative result is that directly imitating a single attempt DESTABILIZES the policy; Memory Models (Letta Jun 2026) frames token-space memory trained with memory-native RL. Verdict delivered to the owner: one try teaches nothing permanently -- one VERIFIED success, distilled, persists; this sandbox has no weights to update (zero model dependency is deliberate) and its contribution to any future trainer is the half both papers require and harnesses lack: verified, receipted experience.
